evidence_ledger.original_pixels: Available and visually inspected; original +224px preview shown.
evidence_ledger.references: Exact five reference strings from SHA-pinned dataset; incomplete and occasionally disagree; not negative labels.
evidence_ledger.clip_tokens: Saved protocol confirms visual cache source/cohort; vectors not in the review ZIP, not probed locally.
evidence_ledger.original_prompt: Embedding source/cohort supported by saved protocols; exact original text not locally recovered; no reconstruction from references.
evidence_ledger.upt: Valid-pair count available only on dev1000 overlap; count is not a relation correctness score; individual hidden vectors/role scores absent.
evidence_ledger.regions: Existing regional supervision/native detail runs have saved captions; auxiliary regions were not caption input at inference for VG G/T. Not an oracle per-case intervention.

limitations: Purposeful diagnostic sample, not a representative error-rate/gain estimate.
Assistant visual judgments, not independently human-verified gold.
Cannot separate encoder missing information, poor alignment and decoder non-use from saved captions alone.
No new inference, training, metric calculation or fresh test.
Raw per-image CIDEr across dev1000 vs val5000 uses different IDF and is not compared.
